The best dog grooming salon in Madrid!

We finally got our Maltipoo a perfect, even scissor cut. The service was excellent, the groomer was very friendly and patient, and we loved the result. You can see the care and professionalism they put into their work. We will definitely be back and we recommend them 100%!

I'm not giving it five stars because of one minor detail: you have to pay at least €8 to use it. In my case, there was plenty of time left over when you're not using it.
The shower is very clean and is disinfected free of charge.
It has a couple of vending machines with pet supplies.
I don't think I'll go back because I can get a shower for less than half the price (it air dries in summer and dries with a towel and €1 for a hairdryer in winter).
excellent

They attended to me very quickly.
The service was excellent, and they did a perfect job on my dog. Washing, haircut, detangling, nails... a very thorough service.
It was a pleasure meeting them. We'll definitely be back.
I'm absolutely delighted with their services; they're very friendly and patient. I loved how my dog ​​looked after both her haircut and grooming. I'll definitely be back.
A great place, fast and at a good price! 👌🏻 …

I called to find out how much they charged to bathe my dog. A very nice guy answered and I found out they had a self-service wash. I went that same day because washing her at home is complicated, and I loved it. They had everything I needed, all new and meticulously done, and most importantly, very cheap considering I called other places in the neighborhood and they were charging exorbitant prices. For €8.50, I got a wash with shampoo, conditioner, flea treatment, rinse, and blow-dry. They have a vending machine with pet treats and are open until 11 pm, including weekends. I hope it stays open for a long time because I've definitely found my go-to place. It's a shame I didn't take any pictures to upload here…
Good afternoon Andrea, thank you so much for your review!

I liked it and I think it's very well adapted for everyone. Thanks again!
I hope to enjoy a relaxing bath with my pet Oreo more often.
They provided excellent service; I loved the way they treated us, and especially how they made my dog ​​look so handsome and adorable. They were so kind and helpful. Thank you so much!
Excellent service!! Very friendly and professional. I highly recommend them. My dog ​​looked beautiful.

I think it's great to be able to go and bathe your own dog. I go every time, and he's always so clean. Plus, it's easy to use. I've also used their grooming service, and the staff are very friendly and do a great job. They made my dog ​​look absolutely gorgeous. I really like it, and I highly recommend it!
I do not recommend this dog grooming service. Poor service, little knowledge, practice, and professionalism. A zero. We will not be returning.
It's an affordable and spacious place to bathe your dog.
Highly recommended for self-service pet washes. Clean, with the option of pre-disinfection, and a good shower and dryer. No appointment necessary.
For small dogs I suppose it'll be fine, but for large ones it's more complicated; plus, it doesn't last very long and a good wash ends up being very expensive.

Spectacular, super well-priced, and what can I say about the manager? He was incredibly friendly, even though I felt a little awkward with how much hair one of my dogs shed. But it was fantastic! I give them a 10 out of 10, and this place is a great find. Thank you so much!
Excellent place and the manager was very friendly.
